edges.description: Loss of ZIP5 zinc import lowers intracellular zinc.
Low zinc destabilizes Smad proteins and blunts R-Smad activation.
Reduced TGF-beta signalling lowers transcription of collagen and other matrix genes.
Proposed step: reduced matrix synthesis in the sclera, where SLC39A5 is expressed, would weaken the scleral wall. Not yet tested in eye tissue.
A weakened sclera is proposed to allow excess axial elongation of the eye.

nodes.description: In SLC39A5 knockout cells, receptor Smad phosphorylation was largely blocked and TGF-beta signalling was inhibited; re-expression of SLC39A5 restored it. The founding study instead reported that wild-type, but not mutant, ZIP5 suppressed Smad1 expression, so patient cells had higher Smad1. Both studies place the defect in BMP/TGF-beta Smad signalling, but they disagree on its direction (see the controversy discussion).

nodes.description: Spectacle lenses with myopic defocus segments (Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments) correct vision and slow myopia progression and axial elongation compared with single-vision lenses. The trial enrolled children with -1.00 to -5.00 D of myopia, and the effect is reported to be smaller in high myopia. Nothing here is specific to SLC39A5. NCIT has no clinical action term for spectacle wear, so the treatment is unbound and the lens is recorded as a device qualifier.

nodes.description: Disease alleles are heterozygous nonsense, frameshift and missense variants. The founding nonsense variant p.Y47* left normal SLC39A5 mRNA levels in patient lymphocytes but reduced protein, consistent with a truncated product, and neither p.Y47* nor p.M304T reproduced the effect of wild-type ZIP5 on Smad1 expression in transfected cells. ZIP5 is a zinc-selective uptake transporter, so loss of one functional copy is expected to reduce cellular zinc import.

nodes.description: Human embryonic kidney cells with SLC39A5 knocked out, used to trace the zinc, Smad and extracellular matrix steps of the proposed mechanism.

Proposed tissue-level mechanism. SLC39A5 is expressed in the sclera and retina throughout mouse eye development, and remodelling of scleral extracellular matrix is a recurring finding in animal myopia models. A sclera with less collagen would be expected to stretch, lengthening the eye. No study has measured scleral matrix in SLC39A5 carriers or in an Slc39a5 animal model.
